How it works

You're personally taken care of

No roads to figure out, no logistics to manage — we handle every detail personally, so all you need to do is arrive, relax, and be looked after.

STEP 01 — ARRIVAL

We meet you at the airport

Early detection

Early detection is early prevention

The CTC test finds circulating tumor cells in a small blood sample — built for patients who've completed chemotherapy and want to monitor recurrence, and for those with a family history who want peace of mind.

  • First in Malaysia to use Negative Selection Technology to isolate tumor cells from blood.
  • Screens using epithelial cancer markers across 21 common cancer types.
  • Non-invasive — only a small blood draw is required, no biopsy.
  • Results are typically ready within 2 to 3 working days.

A Second Opinion from Leading Oncologists

When a diagnosis feels uncertain, you deserve the confidence that comes from another expert perspective. We connect patients across Southeast Asia with leading oncologists in China and access to advanced Gamma Knife technology, where clinically appropriate. If language is a concern, professional translation support can be arranged. After your consultation or treatment, we help coordinate a smooth transition of care with your medical team back home — supporting continuity at every stage of your journey.
